title: Keith's loggia carving read again from the 1888 photograph
items: At 1808 Prairie, the capitals over the paired entrance columns are now what the 1888 plate shows: square stone blocks carved with a running zigzag. The volutes and egg row drawn earlier are gone; a close look at the photograph shows neither.
The balcony's front panel now carries one continuous carved scroll of foliage over a plain base strip, and its corner piers have plain sunk panels.
